name: Millbrae
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Millbrae, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Millbrae, CA: photos with Santa at the Gazebo and the City Hall tree lighting, in a city with a BART and Caltrain hub.
lede: Millbrae packs its Christmas into one December Saturday, with Santa photos at the Gazebo in the afternoon and the City Hall tree lighting at 5 pm, in a town where BART meets Caltrain.
celebrates: The City of Millbrae, the Millbrae Chamber of Commerce and the Millbrae Community Foundation light the city tree in front of City Hall every December. The evening comes with holiday singalongs, hot chocolate, cookies and candy canes. Earlier that afternoon Santa and Mrs. Claus pose for pictures at the Millbrae Gazebo on Poplar and Library Avenue, and if it rains the photos move indoors. The chamber says the tree lighting has taken place since the early 1990s.
lastyear: On Saturday, December 6, 2025, hundreds of people gathered in front of Millbrae City Hall at sunset for the tree lighting, according to the Millbrae Chamber of Commerce. The Millbrae Leos served cookies, the chamber handed out hot chocolate and candy canes, and Santa led a countdown before the tree lit up. Real snow sprayed from the City Hall roof while children played below, and a long line formed for pictures with Santa and Mrs. Claus, who had visited the Gazebo from 2 to 4 pm.
facts: The name Millbrae combines Mills, for the estate of Darius Ogden Mills, with the Scottish word brae, which means rolling hills or hill slope. Millbrae was incorporated on January 14, 1948, and had 23,216 residents at the 2020 census. It sits next to San Francisco International Airport, with San Bruno to the northwest and Burlingame to the southeast.
trains: Millbrae is one of the best train towns on the Peninsula. Millbrae station connects BART, Caltrain and SamTrans, it is the end of the line for BART's Red and Yellow lines, and it is the only place where BART lines connect directly to Caltrain. That makes a Millbrae Christmas outing easy from San Francisco, the airport or the South Bay by train, with the cable car and streetcar museums in San Francisco for a longer train day.
